sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: An entity's Open edits page (the sidebar's "Open edits", e.g. /artist/<id>/open_edits or /recording/<id>/open_edits) gets a "Show all Open Edits" button: every open edit as one row of a filterable, sortable table, the same as the entity's Edits page already gets.

The sidebar's "Open edits" link now has a preview like "Editing history" beside it: hover for a card (how many edits, how many open, the latest, the commonest types), press Space for the window listing them, titled "Open edits".
